observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Canon DSLR camera body with 'Canon' and 'EOS 760D' visible on the top right. The camera is mounted on a black strap with red trim. A lens is visible in the background. The flash is attached and extended.
Photo 1: Front view of the same camera from a slightly different angle. The 'Canon' and 'EOS 760D' text is clearly visible. The camera is on a white surface. The flash is extended.

Photo 2: Side view showing the camera body, lens, and two external flashes. The camera is on a white surface. The strap is visible. The flashes are black and rectangular. The camera body appears to be in good condition with no visible damage.

claims.claim: It is a great and affordable camera for the price
claims.evidence: Subjective claim; cannot be verified from photos alone.

claims.claim: It comes with a bag, microphone and a flash
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows two external flashes, but no bag or microphone is visible. The seller's text claims all three, but none are shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function properly
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the camera powering on, menu navigation, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Lens may be missing or damaged
risks.proof: Photo showing the lens attached to the camera body, or a close-up of the lens barrel and glass.
risks.if_unproven: priced as camera body only, no lens

risks.risk: External flashes may be non-functional or damaged
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the flashes turning on and firing.

risks.risk: Camera may have internal damage or sensor issues
risks.proof: Photo of the camera's LCD screen showing a live image, or a video of the camera in use.

proof_requests: Video or photo showing the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Photo of the lens attached to the camera body.
Video or photo showing the external flashes turning on and firing.
Photo of the camera's LCD screen showing a live image.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
